A roughly 650-year-old Ziarat (shrine) in Jammu holding the Mazhar of Peer Mitha Sahab, tucked within the city's old quarter close to Jammu Airport. Visitors value its peaceful surroundings and architectural detail, though the approach street has narrowed due to congestion.

One of North India's largest Hindu temple complexes, dedicated mainly to Lord Ram with over 33,000 idols and full statues depicting the Dashavatara, plus a significant Shiva shrine on the complex's fourth side. Visitors describe a peaceful, well-organized darshan with knowledgeable priests. A respectful dress code (no shorts) is expected along Raghunath Bazaar.
